headline: Apollo Micro Systems: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure filed under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Kanishka Reddy Baddam has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Apollo Micro Systems Limited, triggering mandatory takeover code disclosures.
detail: Kanishka Reddy Baddam submitted a formal disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 31(4) to NSE, a mandatory filing when an acquirer crosses prescribed shareholding thresholds in a listed company. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure within 2 working days of the acquisition. The filing triggers further obligations including public announcement, open offer requirements, or negotiated acquisition frameworks depending on the slab crossed and acquirer's intent. Apollo Micro Systems is a defence and aerospace electronics manufacturer listed on NSE (ticker: APOLO). The exact shareholding percentage, consideration, and offer intent are specified in the formal disclosure document.
